title.en: Help can be part of a sound handover
title.zh: 帮助也可能是合理交接的一部分

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的一次资料整理中，你拿到两种文件格式，不确定共同约定用哪种，于是请知道安排的人确认。确认格式是在补足任务信息，和已经知道格式却仍希望别人保证自己不会出错，是可以分开描述的动作。两者也可能同时发生；六题频率不区分所有原因，更不能从一次询问推断依赖人格或早年照料。例子关注当时缺什么信息、问了什么和之后怎样继续。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, you receive two file formats for an invented organising task and ask someone who knows which was agreed. Filling an information gap differs from seeking reassurance after the format is known. Both may occur, but six frequency items separate no complete set of causes and infer neither a dependent personality nor early care from one question. Describe the missing information, question and next action.

title.en: Examine one choice without proving independence
title.zh: 看清一次选择，不必证明独立

paragraphs.zh: 可给虚构任务写一张卡：“已知”“想核实的信息”“希望得到的确认”“之后可做的一步”。问：“哪一栏是在描述实际请求，哪一栏是我猜测的原因？”卡片可单独分享，不需要互报分数或用独自完成证明价值。
paragraphs.en: For an invented task, list what is known, information to check, reassurance wanted and a possible next step. Ask which entry describes a request and which guesses a cause. Share the card alone without comparing scores or proving worth through solo completion.

paragraphs.zh: 以上新增情境与讨论卡为费马原创，可以只读或留作私人草稿，不要求联系他人。八主题各六条只回看近四周自己的动作频率，全部正向；完整六条数字回答才显示所属原始和与两位小数均分，NA不补低分，八份全文始终可读。历史词语仅注明出处，不派人格或诊断，也不从近期选择反推童年、身体发育、性、性别或潜意识原因。分享公开指南不包含个人答案或均分。
paragraphs.en: These new FermatMind scenes and cards allow reading or a private draft, without contacting anyone. Eight six-item themes concern your own action frequencies over four weeks, all directly keyed. Six numeric answers are needed for each raw sum and two-decimal mean; NA receives no low-score filling and all eight full guides remain readable. Historical terms identify a reference, assigning no personality or diagnosis and deriving no childhood, bodily development, sexuality, gender or unconscious cause from recent choices. Public guides contain no answers or personal means.

title.en: A short reply may have a practical reason
title.zh: 简短回答可能有实际原因

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构活动有人提出帮你整理公开资料，你先问需要拿到哪一部分、什么时候交回。范围核对可以用中性问题表达；如果语气带刺，具体问题是否已说明、对方是否理解，仍需另看。独自处理、核对条件和冷淡回应也不必有同一原因。较高频率不能证明隐藏的求助愿望，较低也不证明已建立信任；这份清单没有观察另一人的动机或完整互动。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, someone offers help organising public material. You ask which part they need and when it returns. A neutral question can clarify scope; if the tone is sharp, whether the practical question was conveyed remains separate. Solo work, checking conditions and a terse reply need not share a cause. Higher frequency proves no concealed wish for help, and lower frequency certifies no trust. The checklist observes neither the other person’s motives nor the whole interaction.

title.en: Clarify one response in your own notes
title.zh: 在自己的记录里澄清一次回应

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构帮助写一句“我想确认的是……；我能提供的范围是……”。再把推测的语气与实际内容分开。讨论句是：“哪项条件可以直接问，哪项仍不知道？”草稿无需发送，也不必为了练习接受帮助或公开私人需要。
paragraphs.en: Draft the condition to check and the material within scope for invented help. Separate an inferred tone from the stated content. Ask what can be checked directly and what remains unknown. Send nothing and accept no help or disclose no private need for the exercise.

title.en: Changing direction can be the agreed task
title.zh: 改变方向也可能正是约好的任务

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构海报草图阶段，你画出一个新方向，把上一张暂时放下；确定对外使用的版本后，同样的更换可能需要先说明影响。动作都叫“换方向”，却分别发生在探索与已有共同约定之后。先核对阶段、是否有人依赖原安排，以及留下了什么未完事项，比按均分判定任性或创造力更具体。清单没有观察作品质量，也不能从近期分支解释身体发育或固定人格。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, you leave one poster sketch for a new direction during exploration. After a public version is agreed, the same change may need its effects explained. Both are changes, at different stages and under different commitments. Check the stage, anyone relying on the plan and what remains unfinished, rather than judging impulsiveness or creativity from a mean. The checklist observes no work quality and derives no bodily development or fixed personality from recent branching.

title.zh: 让一个值得继续的分支清楚可见

paragraphs.zh: 可给虚构分支写“新可能是什么”“原约定是什么”“我选择继续、替换还是保留”。问：“这是还在探索，还是需要说明一次已定安排的变化？”允许放弃不再重要的想法，不把继续所有分支或压住所有新想法当成目标。
paragraphs.en: For an invented branch, list the new possibility, existing agreement and whether to continue, replace or retain it. Ask whether this is exploration or a change to an agreed plan needing explanation. Leave unimportant ideas behind without pursuing every branch or suppressing all new ones.

title.en: A precise arrangement can belong to the job
title.zh: 精确安排可能来自任务要求

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构展览准备中，标签上的时间与地点需要核对；标签放在桌上哪个角落，可能只是自己的方便习惯。两项都可以被仔细检查，但它们对活动的作用不一定相同。先说明完成标准，再看再查一次发现了什么，才能讨论核对的实际价值。较高频率不证明质量更好或存在障碍，较低也不证明粗心；历史标签无法替这些具体事实提供原因。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, exhibition labels need their time and place checked. A preferred corner of the preparation table may merely be convenient. Both can receive careful attention while serving different purposes. Name the completion criterion and what another check found before discussing value. Higher frequency proves neither quality nor a disorder, and lower frequency proves no carelessness. A historical label supplies no cause for these facts.

title.en: Define what finished means for one small task
title.zh: 为一件小事写清“完成”意味着什么

paragraphs.zh: 可给虚构任务写“影响目的的检查”“方便自己的摆法”“仍未完成的部分”。问：“再查这一项会改变什么可核对的信息？”可以保留有用流程，也可以结束已经足够的核对，不靠分数决定是否需要更多或更少结构。
paragraphs.en: For an invented task, separate purpose-relevant checks, convenient arrangements and unfinished work. Ask what checkable information another check would change. Keep a useful routine or finish a sufficient check without letting a score prescribe more or less structure.

title.en: Explaining a contribution can clarify a shared record
title.zh: 说明贡献也可以是在澄清共同记录

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的小组展示需要一位讲解者，你主动提出承担，并说明自己熟悉哪部分内容。争取一个角色与证明自己是最佳人选是两件事；其他人能否提出替代、任务是否完成、贡献是否被准确记录，也需分别了解。公开说出贡献可以服务交接，也可能与当前议题无关，不能由动作频率判定。均分既不评领导质量，也不证明夸大的自我或隐藏的童年冲突。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a group presentation needs a speaker. You volunteer and name the material you know. Seeking a role differs from proving you are best for it. Alternatives, completion and an accurate contribution record need their own information. Describing a contribution may aid a handover or be irrelevant to the current issue; frequency decides neither. The mean grades no leadership and establishes no grandiose self-view or hidden childhood conflict.

title.en: Write down what you want a proposal to accomplish
title.zh: 写清希望提议实现什么

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构提议写“想实现的结果”“希望承担的角色”“愿意听的替代方案”。讨论句是：“我们在比较任务需要，还是已经给作答者贴了性格标签？”无需刻意变安静、争到角色或互比分数，只把主张说得更具体。
paragraphs.en: For an invented proposal, name the intended result, wanted role and alternatives to hear. Ask whether you compare task needs or have labelled a person. Become no quieter, win no role and compare no scores for the exercise; make the claim more specific.

title.en: The same question can clarify or prolong a discussion
title.zh: 同一个追问可能澄清，也可能拖长讨论

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的小组把“准备完成”理解成两种标准，一人指资料已收齐，另一人指已核对。你提出这一区别，可以帮助明确下一步；标准确定后反复追问同一个词，则可能没有增加信息。两次都涉及论证，效果仍取决于是否存在未决问题。较高均分不证明反例成立、逻辑更强或对方有双重标准，也不能解释隐藏的支配动机。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a group uses “ready” for either collected material or checked material. Naming the difference may clarify the next step. Repeating the word question after agreement may add no information. Both involve analysis, whose value depends on an unresolved issue. A higher mean proves no valid counterexample, stronger logic or double standard in another person, and explains no concealed dominance motive.

title.en: Keep one question connected to its decision
title.zh: 让一个问题与要作的决定保持联系

paragraphs.zh: 可用虚构讨论写“待决定的事”“我的问题”“什么回答足以继续”。问：“这条反例真的改变了原主张，还是只换了一个没说清的条件？”保留合理分歧，不需要辩赢、调查真人动机或用新分数证明推理提升。
paragraphs.en: For an invented discussion, list the decision, question and an answer sufficient to proceed. Ask whether a counterexample changes the claim or introduces an unstated condition. Retain reasonable disagreement without winning a debate, investigating motives or claiming improved reasoning from a new score.

title.en: A lively delivery may be part of an assigned role
title.zh: 生动表达可能来自承担的角色

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的故事活动里，你用明显手势说明一段路线，随后停下来等听者提问。表达鲜明、给别人空间和别人实际是否理解，是三项不同观察。安静的回应不必然表示无兴趣，听者微笑也不一定证明已经理解。六题频率不测受欢迎程度、情绪需要或性别身份；理解一次交流仍要看任务、对方自愿表达和具体反馈，而不是套用历史名称。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, you use visible gestures to describe a route in a storytelling activity, then pause for questions. Vivid delivery, room to respond and actual understanding are separate observations. Quiet replies need not show disinterest, and a smile need not prove comprehension. Six frequency items measure neither popularity, emotional needs nor gender identity. Understand the exchange through its task, voluntary account and feedback rather than a historical name.

title.en: Notice an invitation and a response
title.zh: 观察一次邀请和一次回应

paragraphs.zh: 可写一张虚构交流卡：“我用了什么表达”“希望被理解的内容”“听者实际做了什么”“仍不知道什么”。问：“哪一项是观察，哪一项需要询问？”不用表演更热情或更克制，分享例子也不必附真实互动与分数。
paragraphs.en: Draft an invented exchange card with the expression used, intended meaning, listener’s action and unknowns. Ask which entry is observed and which needs asking. Perform neither greater enthusiasm nor restraint; share the example without a real interaction or score.

title.en: A private draft can prepare a later conversation
title.zh: 私人草稿可以为后续交流作准备

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构地图创作中，你先独自画一版，再决定是否拿给小组看。保留未完成草稿与没有说明别人正在等待的交接时间，是可分开的事：前者可能属于个人探索，后者涉及共同安排。先看哪些内容由自己保留、哪些信息影响任务，不能把私人阶段自动称为疏离。均分不统计创意，也不确定亲近能力、性或隐藏的发育原因。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, you draft an invented map privately before deciding whether to show it. Keeping a draft differs from leaving an awaited handover time unclear: one may concern personal exploration, the other a shared arrangement. Separate retained content from task-relevant information instead of equating a private stage with detachment. The mean counts no creative ideas and determines neither closeness, sexuality nor a hidden developmental cause.

title.en: Make one boundary or next step clearer to yourself
title.zh: 向自己说明一个边界或下一步

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构草稿写“我保留的内容”“共同任务需要的信息”“是否还要有下一步”。最后一栏可以是“不需要”。问：“需要说明安排，是否也必须公开私人内容？”允许只澄清时间、不分享作品，也无需增加社交来证明结果更好。
paragraphs.en: For an invented draft, list retained content, shared-task information and whether a next step is needed. “None” is allowed. Ask whether explaining an arrangement also requires revealing private material. Clarify timing without sharing work or increasing social contact to prove a better result.
